_t4_notes: t4_toa_news captured live 2026-07-26 from news.treeofalpha.com/api/news (8 real rows out of a n=200 sample, verbatim). Measured on that sample: symbols[] present 18/200 and BTC-prefixed 0/200 -- dead code as a BTC test; suggestions[] present 158/200 with coin=="BTC" on 18/200 -- the identifiable field. 105/200 rows carry an isAccountMapped:true suggestion, which maps the POSTER not the text (the Elon Starship row here is tagged DOGE that way), so it is never content evidence. Rows chosen to cover one case each of the relevance evidence ladder: account-mapped-only, symbols, venue notice (Upbit, Korean title -- no English lexicon can reach it), content-mapped BTC, two non-crypto Blogs releases (WHITEHOUSE/CDC -- proof that the transport "source" is not evidence), crypto press, keyword.
_t4_pong_note: t4_bybit_pong captured live 2026-07-27 from wss://stream.bybit.com/v5/public/{linear,spot} by sending {op:'ping'} and keeping the first reply VERBATIM. Note the wire reality the adapter comment depends on: the pong is valid JSON (so it can never reach livewire's isControlFrame branch -- it lands in onMessage), and `op` echoes back as "ping", NOT "pong" -- ret_msg is the field that actually identifies it. The `op === 'pong'` arm of the adapter test is the documented other-gateway fallback and is exercised synthetically in check group 74.
